
Transformations for data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

load(here::here('Short Term Analysis/st_data/04_imputedata.Rda'))

# remove un-needed analytes
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  dplyr::select(!c(contains('AbsCellDensity'),'TotPhos'))

# rename the monreg variables (otherwise they'll get long)

df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  rename(
    graze_rate = monreg_graze_rate,
    clam_biomass = monreg_biomass,
    filt_rate = monreg_filt_rate
  )
```

# derive analytes

```{r}
# create derived analytes
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(DIN = DissAmmonia + DissNitrateNitrite,
         TDN = DON + DissAmmonia + DissNitrateNitrite,
         frac_NH4 = if_else(DIN > 0, DissAmmonia / DIN, NA_real_),
         frac_NN = if_else(DIN > 0, DissNitrateNitrite / DIN, NA_real_),
         frac_NH4_TDN = if_else(TDN > 0, DissAmmonia / TDN, NA_real_),
         frac_DIN = if_else(TDN > 0, DIN / TDN, NA_real_),
         frac_DON = if_else(TDN > 0, DON / TDN, NA_real_))

# create Region x Year x Month clustering unit
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
  region_time = interaction(
    Region, Year, Month,
    drop = TRUE
  ))
```

# factor/re-level relevant analytes

```{r}
df_mvi$Season <- factor(df_mvi$Season,
                        levels = c('Winter', 'Spring', 'Summer', 'Autumn'))

df_mvi$Region <- factor(df_mvi$Region)

df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(mvi_class = relevel(factor(mvi_class), ref = 'HAB'))
```

# log variables

```{r}
log_vars <- c(
  'Chlorophyll',
  'Pheophytin',
  'Conductivity',
  'Turbidity',
  'DissSilica',
  'DissAmmonia',
  'DissNitrateNitrite',
  'DIN',
  'DON',
  'TDN',
  'DissOrthophos',
  'TKN',
  'DissChloride',
  'TDS',
  'SAC',
  'SJR',
  'OUT',
  'EXPORTS',
  'clam_biomass',
  'graze_rate',
  'filt_rate'
)

df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(log_vars),
      log,
      .names = 'log_{.col}'
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(log_vars))
```

# z-score (center & scale)

```{r}
# exclude rel cel density for now
# am including the fractional variables
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric) &
        !any_of(c(
          'Year', 'Month', 'Station', 'Survey', 'Season',
          'Region', 'mvi_class', 'modeled_class', 'region_time'
        )) &
        !contains('RelCellDensity'),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
    )
  )
```

# lag data

Based on what variables I know will be used

```{r}
lag_vars_1mo <- c(
  'log_DissAmmonia', 'log_DissNitrateNitrite', 'log_DIN', 'log_DON',
  'log_TDN', 'frac_NH4', 'frac_DON', 'frac_DIN', 'frac_NH4_TDN',
  'log_DissSilica', 'log_DissOrthophos', 'log_Turbidity',
  'log_graze_rate', 'Temperature', 'log_Conductivity'
)

lag_vars_3mo <- c('log_SJR', 'log_SAC', 'log_EXPORTS', 'log_OUT')

df_lag <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    Year_num = as.numeric(as.character(Year)),
    Month_num = as.numeric(as.character(Month)),
    tindex = Year_num * 12 + Month_num
  ) %>%
  arrange(Station, tindex) %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  mutate(
    gap1 = tindex - dplyr::lag(tindex, 1),
    gap3 = tindex - dplyr::lag(tindex, 3),
    across(
      all_of(lag_vars_1mo),
      ~ if_else(gap1 == 1, dplyr::lag(.x, 1), NA_real_),
      .names = '{.col}_lag'
    ),
    across(
      all_of(lag_vars_3mo),
      ~ if_else(gap3 == 3, dplyr::lag(.x, 3), NA_real_),
      .names = '{.col}_lag3'
    ),
    class_lag = if_else(
      gap1 == 1,
      as.character(dplyr::lag(mvi_class, 1)),
      NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    class_lag = factor(class_lag, levels = levels(df_mvi$mvi_class)),
    Year_c = Year_num - median(unique(Year_num)),
    hab_bin = as.integer(mvi_class == 'HAB'),
    bab_bin = as.integer(mvi_class == 'BAB'),
    mvi_num = as.integer(
      factor(mvi_class, levels = c('HAB', 'No bloom', 'BAB'))
    ) - 1
  )
```

```{r}
check3mo <- df_lag %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  arrange(tindex, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Month_lag3  = dplyr::lag(Month, 3),
    Season_lag3 = dplyr::lag(Season, 3)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(gap3 == 3)

check3mo %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    same_month  = sum(Month == Month_lag3, na.rm = TRUE),
    same_season = sum(Season == Season_lag3, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

# Export

```{r}
df_lag <- df_lag %>%
  select(-c(gap1, gap3))

df_mvi <- df_lag

# FOR NOW, NO CLAMS

df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  select(-c(log_graze_rate, log_graze_rate_lag))
```

```{r}
save(df_mvi, file = here::here('Short Term Analysis/st_data/05_transforms.Rda'))
```
